findings.summary: Luna missed two current menu surfaces: the official rotating Sunday brunch menu and a materially distinct Toast local pickup catalog.
The scout’s baseline-only conclusion is materially wrong: seven claimed absent frozen products are present in the live Toast local pickup catalog.

Current evidence is linked-vendor menu description evidence, not restaurant-issued ingredients. It cannot support complete arrays, negative allergen claims, or cross-contact conclusions; scout milk, wheat, and tree-nut assertions are not all supported by named ingredients.
No restaurant-issued cross-contact disclosure was found. The official dietary-modification warning does not establish shared-equipment or may-contain semantics.

verifier.summary: Independent Terra verification confirmed Baan Mae identity but found that Luna’s catalog is incomplete and its local Toast “beverage” surface characterization is incorrect. The live local pickup catalog restores seven frozen products Luna marked absent and adds other current products; the official rotating brunch page is another missed surface. Restaurant-issued complete allergen and cross-contact evidence remains unavailable, while narrow named-ingredient positives remain linked-vendor evidence only.
